name: v2.2.32
body:
Published to npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ccstatusline

## What's Changed
* [medium] fix(install): keep unreadable Claude settings instead of overwriting them by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/627
* [low] fix(usage): only clear the in-flight lock this render wrote by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/624
* [low] fix(cache-timer): stop reporting HOT after interrupts and local slash commands by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/628
* [low] fix(ansi): never truncate to a line wider than maxWidth by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/625
* [low] perf(ansi): fast-path ASCII and memoise cluster widths by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/633
* [medium] fix(git): stop respawning git outside repos and across session cwds by @elhoim in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/631
* docs: fix stale test and widget counts in AGENTS.md by @wachen in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/533

## New Contributors
* @wachen made their first contribution in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/533

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/compare/v2.2.31...v2.2.32
